verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad first-party REST API (Team, Expenses, Payments, Transactions, Budgets, Accounting) with a quickstart, so its core spend operations can be driven programmatically without the UI. Nothing documents running it in CI pipelines, and the low-code integrations (Pipedream, Zapier) are third-party platforms, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific tooling, documented headless auth/service-account setup for pipelines, any CI/automation-pipeline guide, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Check out our quickstart guide to get up and running making your first Brex API call in just a few minutes.
Team API: Manage users, locations, departments, and cards
Payments API: Manage vendors and send ACH, domestic wires, and checks
Expenses API: View and manage card expenses data, receipt match and receipt uploads
